g.text: Fixed markers assess whether age-associated RNA changes agree across resident immune populations. Il1b detection directions differ across

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: tissues, and the kidney direction reverses in the male-only subset. Values: 24 minus 3 months, in percentage points; n: young/old mice. Different

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: populations, assays and reused mice preclude independent replication or a conserved-mechanism claim.
